DerekArt website

Derek Yaniger’s shop header pairs a bouncing retro logotype with a band of hand-drawn squared spirals in cream, red, and black.

Source
derekart.com
Creator
Derek Yaniger
Style

Moods

Evidence
Captured with tools/capture.mjs (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Third-party work, stored with credit for commentary. License: unverified. Rights policy

Observed

  • The header is flat dusty pink with a centered logotype, “*DEREKart!”, in red and black letters of mixed sizes that bounce off the baseline, with an asterisk star.
  • The menu below is dark geometric sans-serif capitals.
  • A full-width band alternates cream, red, and black blocks with hand-drawn squared spirals in black, red, and gray lines.
  • At the right end of the band, “can you dig it?” is set in a heavy, rounded lowercase face in cream on red.
  • Below, on white, “FEATURED PRINTS” heads three poster thumbnails in saturated blue, yellow, magenta, and green with dense cartoon figures.

Why it belongs

The band shows the rubric’s “pattern as a band” trait directly, and the logotype shows bouncing, mixed lettering.

The featured prints are closer to a psychedelic or tiki revival: saturated, crowded, and outlined. Measured: the CSS sees no chromatic color (the colors are all in images); the screenshot palette finds five hue families.

Borrow

Confine a hand-drawn geometric repeat to one horizontal band under the header.

Let a logotype’s letters change size and bounce off the baseline.
